The '''Battle of Portage Moon''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] during the [[Portage Moon Festival]] when the fishing vessel ''[[Nanda's Luck]]'' crashed into the [[Majestic (pirate ship)|''Majestic'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Quara/Legends|Quara]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Pyash Yopayomba]].<ref name="Ando" />
